pinyin: kǔ hǎi wú biān, huí tóu shì àn
literal: bitter · sea · no · limit, turn · head · is · shore
natural: repent and the shore is near

meaning.en: The sea of suffering is boundless, but if you turn around you will find the shore: a wrongdoer can be saved by repenting.
meaning.zh: 苦难没有尽头，但只要回头就能得救；劝人悔改。

equivalents: it is never too late to turn back
turn over a new leaf and be saved

examples.zh: 警察劝他苦海无边，回头是岸，主动自首。
examples.en: The police urged him that it is never too late to turn back and give himself up.

examples.zh: 苦海无边，回头是岸，你还有机会重新做人。
examples.en: The sea of suffering has a shore if you turn around; you can still start afresh.

usage.en: A Buddhist image: the world is a 'sea of bitterness', and turning one's head shows the shore of salvation. Used to urge wrongdoers to repent.
usage.zh: 佛教用语，以“苦海”喻尘世，“岸”指解脱。多用来劝人改过自新。

pinyin: yīng xióng wú yòng wǔ zhī dì
literal: hero · no · use · martial · 's · place

meaning.en: Having ability but no chance to use it.
meaning.zh: 有才能却没有施展的机会。

equivalents: a talent with nowhere to shine

examples.zh: 他在小公司里英雄无用武之地，只好辞职。
examples.en: In that small firm he had no scope for his talents, so he resigned.

examples.zh: 这里太闭塞，让人觉得英雄无用武之地。
examples.en: This place is so remote that one feels a hero with nowhere to fight.

usage.en: Often used as a lament about one's own situation. Predicate or object.
usage.zh: 常用来感叹怀才不遇、没有舞台。可作谓语或宾语。

origin.source: 晋·陈寿《三国志·蜀书·诸葛亮传》

story.en: In the Records of the Three Kingdoms, Zhuge Liang tells Sun Quan that Liu Bei had no place to use his talents, which is why he fled to Jiangxia. The wording is condensed into the idiom for a capable person lacking an opportunity to show their ability.
story.zh: 《三国志·蜀书·诸葛亮传》载诸葛亮对孙权说，刘备“英雄无所用武，故豫州遁逃至此”。后凝练为“英雄无用武之地”，比喻有才能的人没有施展的机会。

pinyin: hú lu lǐ mài de shì shén me yào
literal: gourd · inside · sell · is · what · medicine

meaning.en: What on earth is someone planning? Used when someone's intention is unclear and a little suspicious.
meaning.zh: 不知道对方心里打的什么主意。

examples.zh: 也不知道他葫芦里卖的是什么药。
examples.en: Nobody knows what he is up to.

examples.zh: 你这葫芦里卖的是什么药？快说说。
examples.en: What's your game? Come on, tell us.

usage.en: Old medicine sellers kept their drugs in gourds, so outsiders couldn't see what was inside. Often 不知道……葫芦里卖的什么药; the verb 卖 may be followed by 的什么药.
usage.zh: 旧时药贩把药装在葫芦里，外人看不见。常说“不知道他葫芦里卖的什么药”。

synonyms: 铁拐李的葫芦——不知卖的啥药

pinyin: yào fēng dé fēng, yào yǔ dé yǔ
literal: want · wind · get · wind, want · rain · get · rain

meaning.en: Having everything go one's way; getting whatever one wants.
meaning.zh: 想要什么就有什么，一切顺心如意。

examples.zh: 他在公司里要风得风，要雨得雨。
examples.en: In the company he gets whatever he wants.

examples.zh: 你以为谁都能要风得风，要雨得雨？
examples.en: Do you think everyone can have things their own way?

usage.en: Sometimes with a hint of envy or criticism, as if someone enjoys special privilege. Often used of someone with power or backing.
usage.zh: 有时含羡慕或讥讽，指有权有势、特别顺利的人。

pinyin: shuō yī qiān, dào yī wàn
literal: say · a thousand, tell · ten thousand
natural: in a word; the long and short of it

meaning.en: No matter how much one says, the point comes down to this; used to introduce the key conclusion.
meaning.zh: 说来说去，归根到底。

equivalents: when all is said and done
at the end of the day

examples.zh: 说一千，道一万，还是得靠自己努力。
examples.en: When all is said and done, you have to rely on your own effort.

examples.zh: 说一千，道一万，关键是诚信。
examples.en: At the end of the day the key is honesty.

usage.en: Introduces the bottom line, usually followed by 还是 / 关键是 / 就是. Sentence adverbial.
usage.zh: 用来引出最后的结论，后面常接“还是”“关键是”“就是”。作句首状语。

pinyin: tóu nǎo jiǎn dān, sì zhī fā dá
literal: head · simple, four limbs · well-developed

meaning.en: Strong in body but simple-minded.
meaning.zh: 身体强壮，却不爱动脑筋。

equivalents: a muscleman without a thought in his head

examples.zh: 别把我当成头脑简单，四肢发达的人。
examples.en: Don't take me for someone who is all brawn and no brains.

examples.zh: 他头脑简单，四肢发达，适合做保镖。
examples.en: He's all muscle and little brain, and fits the bodyguard job.

usage.en: Humorous or insulting, often said of athletes and manual workers; can be self-mocking. Also written without a comma.
usage.zh: 带戏谑或讥讽，常用来说运动员、体力劳动者，也可自嘲。

pinyin: xiān huā chā zài niú fèn shàng
literal: fresh · flower · stuck · on · cow · dung
natural: a beauty paired with an unworthy partner

meaning.en: A beautiful, talented woman married to a man seen as unworthy of her.
meaning.zh: 比喻好女子嫁给了不般配的男人。

examples.zh: 大家都说她嫁给他是鲜花插在牛粪上。
examples.en: Everyone said she was a flower stuck on a heap of dung to have married him.

examples.zh: 别说什么鲜花插在牛粪上，人家过得挺好的。
examples.en: Don't go on about a flower on dung; they live well.

usage.en: Often mocking and rather rude; in modern use sometimes jokingly said by the husband himself. Can be reversed for a mismatch the other way.
usage.zh: 有贬低意味，较粗俗；现也有丈夫自嘲的说法。

pinyin: niǎo bù lā shǐ, jī bù shēng dàn
literal: birds · don't · poop, hens · don't · lay eggs

meaning.en: A barren, remote, desolate place where nothing thrives.
meaning.zh: 形容偏僻荒凉、贫瘠的地方。

examples.zh: 他被派到一个鸟不拉屎，鸡不生蛋的地方工作。
examples.en: He was posted to a godforsaken place.

examples.zh: 这村子鸟不拉屎，鸡不生蛋，谁愿意来？
examples.en: The village is the back of beyond; who'd want to come?

usage.en: Crude and exaggerated. The set phrase often gains a third clause: 鸟不拉屎，鸡不生蛋，狗不拉屎. Often attributive: 鸟不拉屎的地方.
usage.zh: 较粗俗夸张。常说“鸟不拉屎的地方”。

pinyin: yǒu yī shuō yī, yǒu èr shuō èr
literal: have · one · say · one, have · two · say · two

meaning.en: To state things as they are, adding and leaving out nothing.
meaning.zh: 有什么就说什么，实事求是，不夸大。

examples.zh: 有一说一，有二说二，这件事不是他的责任。
examples.en: To be fair, this wasn't his fault.

examples.zh: 我是有一说一，有二说二，你别生气。
examples.en: I'm telling it as it is, so don't be offended.

usage.en: A very popular internet opener, often shortened to 有一说一, introducing a fair or blunt comment, sometimes just before criticism.
usage.zh: 网络上很流行，常缩略为“有一说一”，用于引出客观或直率的评价。

pinyin: yǒu bǎi lì ér wú yī hài
literal: have · a hundred · benefits · and · not · one · harm

meaning.en: Beneficial in many ways and harmful in none.
meaning.zh: 好处很多，一点坏处都没有。

examples.zh: 多读书有百利而无一害。
examples.en: Reading more has only benefits and no drawbacks.

examples.zh: 坚持锻炼有百利而无一害。
examples.en: Keeping up exercise brings every benefit and no harm.

usage.en: Typically follows an activity as subject. Also written 有百利而无一弊. Used in advice, advertising and health talk; sometimes ironic.
usage.zh: 多用于劝告、广告和养生话题，偶尔带讽刺。

pinyin: dōng yī láng tóu xī yī bàng zi
literal: east · one · hammer · west · one · club

meaning.en: Working without a plan or focus, doing a bit here and a bit there.
meaning.zh: 做事没有计划，不专心，想到哪儿干到哪儿。

equivalents: flit from one thing to another

examples.zh: 他做事东一榔头西一棒子，一事无成。
examples.en: He does things piecemeal and achieves nothing.

examples.zh: 复习要有计划，不能东一榔头西一棒子。
examples.en: Revision needs a plan, not a bit here and a bit there.

usage.en: Used mostly of unfocused work or study; also 东一榔头，西一棒槌 in some regions.
usage.zh: 多形容做事缺乏计划和重点。

pinyin: shí jiān shì bǎ shā zhū dāo
literal: time · is · a · pig-slaughtering · knife

meaning.en: Time is merciless and wears everyone down, especially on looks and youth.
meaning.zh: 时间无情，会让人容颜衰老、青春消逝。

examples.zh: 同学聚会，才发现时间是把杀猪刀。
examples.en: At the reunion we saw that time is a merciless blade.

examples.zh: 时间是把杀猪刀，当年的帅哥都发福了。
examples.en: Time is a butcher's knife; the old heart-throbs have all put on weight.

usage.en: Internet-era remark, now a jocular comment on ageing, often with 岁月 variants like 岁月是把杀猪刀.
usage.zh: 网络流行语，调侃岁月无情，也说“岁月是把杀猪刀”。

text: 明知山有虎，偏向虎山行
pinyin: míng zhī shān yǒu hǔ, piān xiàng hǔ shān xíng
literal: clearly · know · mountain · has · tiger, deliberately · toward · tiger · mountain · go

meaning.en: To push on toward danger deliberately, out of courage or determination.
meaning.zh: 明明知道危险，却偏要迎难而上。

equivalents: walk into the tiger's den on purpose

examples.zh: 明知山有虎，偏向虎山行，他还是接下了任务。
examples.en: Knowing the danger, he took on the task anyway.

examples.zh: 记者明知山有虎，偏向虎山行，深入灾区报道。
examples.en: Reporters knowingly went into the danger zone to cover the disaster.

usage.en: From the Peking opera 《智取威虎山》; the line is sung by the hero as he goes up to the tigers' mountain. Often used of brave or reckless action.
usage.zh: 出自京剧《智取威虎山》唱词，形容明知危险仍勇往直前。

pinyin: shàng tiān wú lù, rù dì wú mén
literal: up · to heaven · no · road, into · earth · no · door

meaning.en: Having no way out at all; trapped and desperate.
meaning.zh: 走投无路，没有任何出路。

equivalents: at the end of one's rope

examples.zh: 他欠了一屁股债，真是上天无路，入地无门。
examples.en: Deep in debt, he had nowhere to turn.

examples.zh: 被警察包围后，罪犯上天无路，入地无门。
examples.en: Surrounded by the police, the criminal had no way out.

usage.en: Often 落得 / 真是 + phrase. A fairly vivid literary-colloquial exclamation of being stuck.
usage.zh: 常说“真是……”“落得……”，较形象的感叹。

text: 不怕神一样的对手，就怕猪一样的队友
pinyin: bù pà shén yī yàng de duì shǒu, jiù pà zhū yī yàng de duì yǒu
literal: not · fear · god-like · opponent, only · fear · pig-like · teammate

meaning.en: A team can handle even strong opponents; it is incompetent teammates who ruin things.
meaning.zh: 强大的对手不可怕，可怕的是拖后腿的队友。

equivalents: it's not the strong opponent but the useless teammate that sinks you
better a strong rival than a hopeless teammate

examples.zh: 打游戏时常说：不怕神一样的对手，就怕猪一样的队友。
examples.en: Gamers often say: don't fear god-like opponents, fear pig-like teammates.

examples.zh: 这次项目失败了，真是不怕神一样的对手，就怕猪一样的队友。
examples.en: The project failed; it really is the clueless teammate you need to fear, not the strong rival.

usage.en: Internet saying, from online gaming culture, often said jokingly or angrily after a loss caused by a teammate.
usage.zh: 来自网络游戏圈的流行语，常在队友失误后半开玩笑或气愤地说。

pinyin: rén shēng hé chù bù xiāng féng
literal: in life · where · not · meet
natural: we are bound to meet again

meaning.en: Wherever you go in life, you will meet again; said with surprise at an unexpected encounter, or at parting.
meaning.zh: 人生处处都有重逢的机会；用于意外相遇或告别时。

examples.zh: 没想到在这儿碰到你，人生何处不相逢！
examples.en: Fancy meeting you here; it's a small world!

examples.zh: 今天告别，人生何处不相逢，后会有期。
examples.en: We part today, but life brings many reunions; until we meet again.

usage.en: Common in songs and everyday speech; related to 山水有相逢.
usage.zh: 常见于歌词和口头表达，可表示意外重逢，也用于告别。

pinyin: shén me fēng bǎ nǐ chuī lái de
literal: what · wind · took · you · blew · here

meaning.en: A friendly greeting for an unexpected visitor: 'What wind blew you here?'
meaning.zh: 对意外来客的客气问候，相当于“你怎么来了”。

examples.zh: 哟，什么风把你吹来的？好久不见！
examples.en: Well, what brings you here? Long time no see!

examples.zh: 老同学，什么风把你吹来的？
examples.en: Old friend, what wind blew you in?

usage.en: A greeting; an alternative is 哪阵风把你吹来了. Often teasing or warm.
usage.zh: 问候语，也可说“哪阵风把你吹来了”，口气亲切或带玩笑。

pinyin: lái wú yǐng, qù wú zōng
literal: come · no · shadow, go · no · trace
natural: come and go without a trace

meaning.en: Appearing and vanishing without a trace; elusive and mysterious.
meaning.zh: 来去都没有踪迹，行踪不定，神秘莫测。

equivalents: come and go like a ghost

examples.zh: 那个小偷来无影，去无踪，警察抓不到。
examples.en: The thief comes and goes without a trace, and the police can't catch him.

examples.zh: 他这个人来无影，去无踪，很难联系。
examples.en: He comes and goes unseen, which makes him hard to reach.

usage.en: Typically used of swordsmen in martial-arts fiction, spies, thieves, and modern 'ghost' friends. Often 来无影去无踪.
usage.zh: 常用于武侠小说中的侠客、盗贼、间谍，也可说行踪不定的人。

pinyin: shí zhǐ bù zhān yáng chūn shuǐ
literal: ten · fingers · not · touch · spring · water

meaning.en: Pampered and never having to do any household chores.
meaning.zh: 养尊处优，不做家务活。

examples.zh: 她从小十指不沾阳春水，哪会做饭？
examples.en: She's never lifted a finger as a child; how would she know how to cook?

examples.zh: 这位大小姐十指不沾阳春水。
examples.en: This young lady has never had to touch housework.

usage.en: A line often linked to women of wealthy families; 阳春水 is spring water that is still cold, hence hard work. Sometimes with a touch of mockery.
usage.zh: 多形容富家小姐，“阳春水”指春天的凉水。有时略带讥讽。

pinyin: qián mén jù hǔ, hòu mén jìn láng
literal: front · door · repel · tiger, back · door · admit · wolf
natural: out of the frying pan into the fire

meaning.en: Driving off one danger only to let in another.
meaning.zh: 刚刚摆脱一种祸害，又遇上另一种祸害。

equivalents: out of the frying pan into the fire

examples.zh: 摆脱了高利贷，又被诈骗，真是前门拒虎，后门进狼。
examples.en: He escaped loan sharks only to be conned: from the frying pan into the fire.

examples.zh: 这政策前门拒虎，后门进狼，反而更糟。
examples.en: The policy repels one danger and admits another, and is even worse.

usage.en: Often said of events and policies. The variant 前门打虎 is also used.
usage.zh: 常见说法，也说“前门打虎，后门进狼”。

pinyin: zhù rén wéi kuài lè zhī běn
literal: help · others · is · happiness · 's · root
natural: helping others is the root of happiness

meaning.en: Helping other people is the source of true happiness.
meaning.zh: 帮助别人是快乐的根本。

equivalents: helping others is the key to happiness
give and you shall be happy

examples.zh: 他常说助人为快乐之本。
examples.en: He often says that helping others is the root of happiness.

examples.zh: 志愿者们都认为助人为快乐之本。
examples.en: The volunteers all feel that helping others is the foundation of happiness.

usage.en: A moral slogan for community and school campaigns. Formal-ish, often as a motto.
usage.zh: 常用作校园、社区倡导的格言。

pinyin: yán yǐ lǜ jǐ, kuān yǐ dài rén
literal: strict · in · discipline · self, lenient · in · treating · others
natural: strict with oneself, generous with others

meaning.en: Hold oneself to a strict standard but treat others with tolerance.
meaning.zh: 对自己要求严格，对别人宽容。

equivalents: be strict with yourself and kind to others
hold yourself to high standards but forgive others

examples.zh: 做领导要严以律己，宽以待人。
examples.en: A leader must be strict with themselves and tolerant to others.

examples.zh: 他一向严以律己，宽以待人，深受尊敬。
examples.en: He has always demanded a lot of himself and been generous to others, and is much respected.

usage.en: A classic maxim of conduct, quoted in speeches and mottos; the opposite pattern is 严以待人，宽以律己. Also written without the comma.
usage.zh: 常见格言；反面是“宽以律己，严以待人”。也有不加逗号的写法。
